label: Town of Essex

# Town of Essex municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 8; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Charter of the Town of Essex, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 117 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 201 provides that the elected officers of the town are Selectboard members and Moderator; section 202 fixes a Selectboard of five.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Essex Selectboard members Kendall Chamberlin, Shannon Jackson, and Ethan Lawrence among the board.

Town of Essex OFFICIAL RESULTS, March 3, 2026 election (essexvt.gov): Andy Watts (977 votes) and Meg Zimmerman (1,012) won the two 3-year seats and Ethan Lawrence (760) won the 1-year remainder seat on March 3, 2026; Chamberlin and Jackson won their seats in 2025 and hold them to 2028. The remainder seat opened when Chair Tracey Delphia resigned January 19, 2026; she is not minted.
Charter of the Town of Essex, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 117 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 201 lists the Moderator among the town's elected officers.
Town of Essex OFFICIAL RESULTS, March 3, 2026 election (essexvt.gov): John Sonnick was elected Moderator with 1,286 votes on March 3, 2026.
Charter of the Town of Essex, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 117 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): the charter's manager form of government makes the Town Clerk an appointed office.
Town of Essex OFFICIAL RESULTS, March 3, 2026 election (essexvt.gov): Tatsiana Bussiere attests the March 3, 2026 official results as Town Clerk; she is recorded as the appointed holder.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Jennifer Booker as ACTING Town Clerk of Essex (January 2026), superseded by Bussiere's attestation of the March 2026 results.
Charter of the Town of Essex, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 117 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): the charter's manager form of government makes the Town Treasurer an appointed office.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Jennifer Booker as ACTING Town Treasurer of Essex (January 2026); no official source publishes a current holder, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Town of Essex justices of the peace: Alyssa Black, Iris Banks, Leonora Dodge, Alexis Dubief, Betsy Dunn, Rey Garofano, Dawn Hill-Fleury, Georgia Lavigne, Erik Post, Cindy Seivwright, Ken Signorello, Margaret Smith, Liz Subin, Laura Taylor, and Irene Wrenner. Black, Dodge, and Garofano are the sitting Chittenden-24 and Chittenden-23 state representatives, each styled 'of Essex' in the House Journal; their existing state-tier person records are reused.
